open: Position of the elevator and escalators (DSB lists them; OSM has none).
Hornbæk Line (Lokaltog) halt: Wikipedia says it is on the street next to the station building; position and name not in OSM extract or owner text.
Waiting room and toilet hours: DSB gives only 'closed/locked evenings and nights'.

365discount (OSM n2270460295, Mo-Su 07:00-22:00), HaiYi and Sweet Ship are 10–20 m from the platforms in OSM, probably in the ferry terminal/harbour buildings; no source says they are in the station, so left out.
No owner plan found; level names not signposted in any source.

answers.question: (no station-specific open questions were listed for Helsingør)
answers.answer: Terminus with 3 platforms/5 tracks and the station building at the buffer end, so the platforms are reached at grade. DSB lists an elevator to the forhal and ferry terminal plus stairs and escalators (positions not given); OSM has no lifts or escalators here.
